from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u047/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    # Repeat the outer row and column once, keeping the interior dimensions.\n    row_indices = [0] + list(range(len(grid))) + [len(grid) - 1]\n    col_indices = [0] + list(range(len(grid[0]))) + [len(grid[0]) - 1]\n    return [[grid[r][c] for c in col_indices] for r in row_indices]\n'''
file_path=program_dir/'task-c772bd99.py'
file_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(file_path), 'exec'), globals())
